notes.title: Now with 800% as many skins!!!
notes.notes: The skins are linked to the gold achievement times.

notes.title: Big changes!
notes.notes:
Version 1.1 brings big changes to Runner:
[list]
The UI has been revamped
The player collision body has been improved
New skins available!
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes, second update June3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Previous update was left in windowed mode used for debugging and dev. This update sets the game back to fullscreen.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for June 3, 2024
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*]Added hotkeys for resetting a run (R) and pause/resume (Esc). 
[list]
[*]Previously players had to go to the options menu and hit the Reset button. 
[*]The Esc key already worked to pause the game, but did not resume the game.
[/list]
[*]New high scores weren't being reflected in the high score panel in the game, that should be fixed now. 
[/olist]
